meta.purpose: Offline accuracy reference for the horoscope ephemeris (development only; never fetched at runtime).
meta.frame: geocentric apparent ecliptic longitude, true ecliptic and equinox of date (IAU76/80), degrees
meta.timeScale: UTC instants (Unix ms); Horizons queried in UT. UT1-UTC (<0.9 s) is ignored.

positions.source: NASA/JPL Horizons API, observer table quantity 31 (ObsEcLon), centre 500@399

velocitiesAndEvents.velocity: central difference of the same longitude over +-1 hour, degrees per day
velocitiesAndEvents.stationTolerance: 10 s bisection of the velocity sign
